dose.population: DMD mutations amenable to single-exon skipping (exon 44, 45, 51 or 53)
dose.note: Kidney-toxicity NOAEL exposures in monkey and juvenile rat were 20-fold and 6-fold the AUC of boys dosed 30 mg/kg weekly; no laboratory sign of renal toxicity in patients. Retrodiction: margins first public in 2016, after eteplirsen's own patient tolerability (Mendell 2013).
dose.short: Renal NOAEL margin held at 30 mg/kg
dose.quote: Mean eteplirsen plasma exposures (AUC) at the NOAELs for monkey and juvenile rat were 20-fold and 6-fold, respectively, greater than that in patients dosed once weekly with 30 mg/kg IV eteplirsen.
dose.confidence_note: Margin from the bundled 206488 PharmR (patient AUC from Study 4658-US-202, NCT01540409, results posted 2019-07-10); patient renal side from 206488 MedR: 'There was no laboratory indication of renal toxicity'. The PharmR also states margins against 'anticipated human exposure', so a margin existed before dosing, but its pre-dosing value is not public.
dose.reason: Tox margin held at the dosed exposure
dose.judgement: Decision 16: a stated tolerability margin (NOAEL above the effective exposure) that held in patients scores dose same with margin_stated true; the harm never appeared, so it is counted here, not in safety. Eteplirsen only; golodirsen's small margin is not scored here. Ruling 2026-11-09: for dose only the same drug's own earlier patient result counts; eteplirsen patients were dosed at 30-50 mg/kg without renal toxicity in Mendell 2013, before the 2016 review stated these NOAEL margins, so the held margin is a retrodiction (retro), not same.
dose.magnitude_basis: plasma AUC at kidney NOAEL vs patient AUC at 30 mg/kg weekly (20x monkey, 6x juvenile rat)
dose.model: Rodent and cynomolgus monkey GLP toxicology

efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: the mdx model was relied on to predict functional benefit from exon skipping; RACER53's primary was functional, so it scores here as contra. Wu 2011 (no function at 2.6% dystrophin) arguably foresaw failure at human dystrophin levels, but no source framed that as a prediction for patients. ESSENCE (golodirsen arm, Sarepta 2025-11-03, P=0.309) recorded as a patient trial.

efficacy.judgement: Paired by me. Golodirsen (also selected in patient myoblasts per FDA pharm review) recorded as a patient trial; outcome_tested negative from RACER53 and ESSENCE. Ruling 2026-11-09: efficacy is a claim about the target; the viltolarsen run of the patient-cell model (Watanabe 2018) was first public after eteplirsen raised dystrophin in boys (Cirak 2011, Mendell 2013), so the viltolarsen track is a retrodiction: retro, not same.

safety.judgement: Opening entry; eteplirsen's findings were minimal and carried no label warning, so no named prediction is scored for it.

safety.judgement: Same direction as golodirsen. Vesleteplirsen (PPMO) was stopped in 2024 for hypomagnesemia and declining kidney function, which would match renal prediction, but its nonclinical renal findings were not found in a public source, so it is not scored.
